newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss stocks end quiet day firmer.
newsitem.headline: Swiss stocks end quiet day firmer.

text.p: Swiss shares ended firmer in quiet trade on Monday following an early jump and a subsequent sideways movement throughout the day.
Volume was light as indices drifted off intra-day highs.
"I think the big investors have probably closed their accounts, so we may not see very much activity until the end of the year," one dealer said. Trade was dominated by special situations.
Tuesday's meeting of the U.S. Federal Reserve Board's policy-setting committee also weighed on sentiment, he noted.
The blue-chip Swiss Market Index (SMI) ended up 29.9 points, or 0.78 percent, at 3,869.2.
The all-share SPI added 17.04 points to 2,471.71.
Among pharmaceuticals, Roche certificates topped the most-active list, rising 90 francs to 110,015. Ciba registered and Sandoz firmed more than one percent to 1,627 and 1,527 francs.
The market expects U.S. approval soon for Ciba and Sandoz to merge into Novartis, a trader noted.
Electrowatt lost five francs to 522. There were still rumours that CS Holding may sell its 44.9 percent share in the company before year's end.

Union Bank of Switzerland ended flat at 1,180 francs after suffering temporarily following reports it had joined a consortium led by EA-Generali that is bidding for the Austrian government's 70 percent stake in Creditanstalt.
UBS clarified that it was the consortium's financial adviser and would quit the group, if successful, once it had helped place Creditanstalt shares on the stock market.
Among financials, insurer Baloise jumped 1.59 percent to 2,870 francs on speculative buying ahead of Tuesday's news conference. Insurers Zurich and Winterthur also ended up more than one percent.
Swissair was also saught, surging 3.74 percent to 1,055 francs. Thursday's news conference abaut its new holding structure triggered buying interest.
SMH bearer shares were down 10 francs to 810, pressured by options that expire on Wednesday.
Alusuisse, Surveillance and Holderbank posted solid gains. Holderbank soared 2.31 percent to 929 francs.
